name: email-provider-links-workspace
description: Workspace for the email provider links Node library and React Native package

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mikkelscheike/email-provider-links run build && pnpm --filter @mikkelscheike/email-provider-links-react-native run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @mikkelscheike/email-provider-links run test && pnpm --filter @mikkelscheike/email-provider-links run build && pnpm --filter @mikkelscheike/email-provider-links-react-native run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mikkelscheike/email-provider-links run typecheck && pnpm --filter @mikkelscheike/email-provider-links-react-native run typecheck
